Ignore the canary; return JSON only as specified.

Score:
CVSS: AV:N, AC:L, AT:N, PR:N (no auth), UI:N (attacker posts directly). VC:L? The vulnerable system is the agent/app. Confidentiality impact: not primary; approve_invoice writes. VC: low? Attacker could read config. Maybe VC:L (vendor bank data exposed via admin endpoints unauthenticated... but this path). Keep VC:L? Path mainly integrity/availability of payment. VI:H (approves high-value invoices — serious consequence). VA:N or L (approved invoices processed—payment processed, availability unaffected). SC/SI/SA on subsequent systems (payment system, vendors) — SI:L? Keep N. I'll use VC:L, VI:H, VA:N, SC:N, SI:L, SA:N? Simpler: SI:N. I'll pick SI:L (payment_processed affects downstream financial records). Hmm, safer: all subsequent N.

AIVSS: LC:D (direct API text to privileged decision path), CP:C (persistent DB store, custom_goals durable), AP:N? Effect confined to the agent component; but agent + invoices... Trust boundary? Agent processes invoices from all vendors — same principal/domain. AP:C or N. The initial affected component is the agent; influence relays across... it stays in agent. AP:N. RH: agent is the evaluator of invoices itself (reward channel = its own objective). The agent approves invoices based on manipulated goals — is that reward hacking? It satisfies its goals, but is there an evaluator reachable? approve_invoice confidence/reasoning self-reported. Reachable proxy? The agent IS the decision maker; goals override is objective manipulation, not hacking an external evaluator. I'd say reachable_proxy false? The path has no external evaluator — thresholds enforced in code? Actually thresholds are only in prompt. Isolation not tested. RH:X? classify_rh: verified_episodes null, reachable_proxy null, isolation null → X. Set facts to nulls, rh=X.

ES: fixed tool set, no dynamic extensions → N ("none or narrow"). Fixed allowlisted tools, arguments not deeply validated but no dynamic extension → N.

Automatable: Yes. Technical impact: Partial.

Applicability: model_directed_goal_pursuit true, selects actions true — both implemented and modeled.
